subject: Problem with finding the function getNimbleOption in parallel runs

messages.author: bc11fbb928eb77ff
messages.subject: Problem with finding the function getNimbleOption in parallel runs
parts:
Dear all,

I get the following problem in the development of the new version of package runMCMCbtadjust, trying to allow parallelization of Nimble: the error I get is that it is impossible to find function getNimbleOption. The only way out I have found was to re-load Nimble in each cluster but CRAN does not accept may package with this (this produced a NOTE). I will have to ask users to enter themselves an expression to do this but this will not render their life easier!!! So if you could solve this problem this would be nice.

Here is a code to reproduce the error:

set.seed(1)
y1000<-rnorm(n=1000,mean=600,sd=30)

library(coda)
library(nimble)
nimbleOptions(MCMCusePredictiveDependenciesInCalculations = TRUE)
nimbleOptions(MCMCorderPosteriorPredictiveSamplersLast = FALSE)
nimbleOptions(enableDerivs = TRUE)


ModelData<-data <-list(mass = y1000)
ModelConsts<-constants <- list(nobs = length(y1000))

ModelCode<-nimble::nimbleCode(
  {
    # Priors
    population.mean ~ dunif(0,5000)
    population.sd ~ dunif(0,100)
   
    # Normal distribution parameterized by precision = 1/variance in Nimble
    population.variance <- population.sd * population.sd
    precision <- 1 / population.variance
 
    # Likelihood
    for(i in 1:nobs){
      mass[i] ~ dnorm(population.mean, precision)
    }
  })


ModelInits <- function()
{list (population.mean = rnorm(1,600,90), population.sd = runif(1, 1, 30))}
 
Nchains <- 3
n.adapt<-1000

set.seed(1)
Inits<-inits<-lapply(1:Nchains,function(x){ModelInits()})

#specifying the names of parameters to analyse and save:
params <- c("population.mean", "population.sd")

code=ModelCode
thin<-10
nburnin.min0<-nburnin<-100
niter<-1000

########################################
###0-2. initial preparation of MCMC models: process differs depending on MCMC_language
########################################

cl<-parallel::makeCluster(Nchains, timeout = min(5184000))
    parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("code", "inits", "data", "constants", "params",
                        "niter", "thin"))
for (j in seq_along(cl)) {
      set.seed(j)
      if(is.function(inits)) {
        init <<- inits()
      } else {
        init <<- inits[[j]]
      }
  clusterNumber<-j
      parallel::clusterExport(cl[j], "init")
  parallel::clusterExport(cl[j], "clusterNumber")
    }

out1 <- parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, {

Nchains<-i<-1
Model <- vector("list", Nchains)
CModelMCMC <- vector("list", Nchains)
CModel <- vector("list", Nchains)
ConfModel <- vector("list", Nchains)
ModelMCMC <- vector("list", Nchains)

Model[[i]] <- nimble::nimbleModel(code = code, name = 'Nimble', constants = constants, data = data)
CModel[[i]] <- nimble::compileNimble(Model[[i]])
ConfModel[[i]] <- nimble::configureMCMC(Model[[i]], thin = thin, monitors = params)
ModelMCMC[[i]] <- nimble::buildMCMC(ConfModel[[i]])
CModelMCMC[[i]] <- nimble::compileNimble(ModelMCMC[[i]], project = CModel[[i]])

      return(NULL)
      gc(verbose = FALSE)
    })

Thanks very much in adavance. Sincerely,

Frédéric

messages.author: bc11fbb928eb77ff
messages.subject: Re: Problem with finding the function getNimbleOption in parallel runs
parts:
Actually, CRAN finally accepted to load nimble in parallel clusters and to publish V1.1.0 of runMCMCbtadjust (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/runMCMCbtadjust/index.html). The "problem" is therefore less urgent and is actually the same as the one discussed in : https://groups.google.com/g/nimble-users/c/-pDY9dB9ovE/m/X7COhFCyAQAJ. Sorry for duplication. This one can be closed.


Frédéric
